identity.title: Distributions of molecules in the circumnuclear disk and surrounding starburst ring in the Seyfert galaxy NGC 1068 observed with ALMA
identity.journal: Publications of the Astronomical Society of Japan

paper_type_evidence.quote: This is the first paper reporting our study of molecular distributions in NGC 1068 with the ALMA early science program.

evidence.quote: Throughout the paper, we assume that the distance of NGC 1068 is 14.4 Mpc (cite: tully1988; bland1997); at this distance, $1''$ corresponds to 72 pc.

question.value: How are molecules distributed between the circumnuclear disk and the starburst ring of NGC 1068, and what does this say about AGN and starburst effects on molecular abundances?

evidence.quote: These observations were motivated to study the effects of an active galactic nucleus and its surrounding starburst ring on molecular abundances.
This paper makes use of the ALMA data ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00061.S.
The receivers in band 3 (100 GHz region) were used.

evidence.quote: Each spectral window covered 1875 MHz with 3840 channels resulting in a frequency resolution of 488 kHz.
The 16 antennas available were in the compact configuration.

with an angular resolution of $\sim4''\times2''$ (290 pc$\times$140 pc)
